gridLayout.rationale: Layout component (article-grid / vertical-standard) → EDS section; bgCerulean / blueShade / minimal-padded → section-metadata styles.

heroBanner.rationale: Background image (desktop + mobile ) with heading, copy and optional CTA overlaid → Hero.

text-image-with-zoom.rationale: Image beside heading + copy (imageTextLeft / imageTextRight modifiers → Columns variant order); image opens a zoom modal (data-toggle) — use the boilerplate modal/lightbox enhancement.

accordionItem.rationale: Expand/collapse items grouped by data-accordiongroup ('Show more') → Accordion. Specification panels nest richText + table components (Medium).

contactus.rationale: Enquiry form (location select, name, email, phone, comments) with reCAPTCHA (data-sitekey) posting to a Fonterra backend — no form block in the boilerplate library; needs a form block + submission integration.

table.rationale: Specification table → Table. DEFECT: on the live site these 7 instances render the Granite/Coral authoring UI ('There is no item' / 'Loading more items', coral-wait) instead of data — re-author the spec data from the PDFs during migration.

subsection.rationale: Headline (+ blue underline) and copy → default content (heading style via section metadata).

downloadFile.rationale: Short copy + single button (Contact us / PDF download) in a tinted strip → default-content text + button inside a styled section.
